name: com.andreleandrodev.mihordetraffic
description: Crowd pathfinding for thousands of agents, where the crowd is aware of itself. Replaces per agent A* with a single flow field expansion that serves the whole horde, and prices every cell by how fast bodies actually cross it, so a jammed route becomes expensive and a second route opens on its own without anything having to notice the jam or decide a detour is worthwhile. Works on a 3D navmesh or in a top down 2D scene on the XY plane, where walls are read from 2D colliders and tilemaps. Includes jobified reactive separation, crowd slowing, settling around a target, a scene setup tool, a live advisor that names which setting is costing the most, and a runtime switch to stock NavMeshAgent so any performance claim can be checked rather than believed.

samples.description: A spawner and an optional body script for a crowd driven by the flow field. Shows what HordeAgent already does and what a game adds on top.
A spawner and a mouse driven target for a top down 2D crowd on the XY plane, with walls read from 2D colliders.
A spawner for a stock NavMeshAgent crowd using HordeEntity, for comparing against the flow field in the same scene.
